## Rank and Invertibility of a Tall Matrix

Builds a 3-by-2 matrix, checks the ranks of A, A'A, and AA', and attempts both inverses.

```{webr}
library(Matrix)

A_tall <- matrix(c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1), nrow = 3, ncol = 2)
c(rank_A = rankMatrix(A_tall),
  rank_AtA = rankMatrix(t(A_tall) %*% A_tall),
  rank_AAt = rankMatrix(A_tall %*% t(A_tall)))

solve(t(A_tall) %*% A_tall)       # exists
try(solve(A_tall %*% t(A_tall)))  # singular
```

## Three Ways to Compute A'B

Constructs two 3-by-2 matrices and computes A'B directly, entry by entry, and as a sum of row outer products.

```{webr}
A=matrix(c(1,2,3,4,5,6),3,2)
B=matrix(c(2,3,4,5,6,7),3,2)
## 1. Calculate AB by R
t(A)%*%B
## 2. Representation 1
C1=matrix(0,2,2)
for (i in 1:2){
  for (j in 1:2){
    C1[i,j]=sum(A[,i]*B[,j])
  }
}
C1
## 3. Representation 2
C2=matrix(0,2,2)
tA1=matrix(A[1,],2,1);tA2=matrix(A[2,],2,1)
tA3=matrix(A[3,],2,1);B1=matrix(B[1,],1,2)
B2=matrix(B[2,],1,2);B3=matrix(B[3,],1,2)
C2=tA1%*%B1+tA2%*%B2+tA3%*%B3
C2
```

## Eigenvectors of a Jordan Matrix

Computes the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 2-by-2 Jordan matrix.

```{webr}
J=matrix(c(1,0,1,1),2,2)
eigen(J)
```

## Eigenvalues Before and After Inversion

Computes the rank and eigenpairs of a symmetric matrix and compares them with the eigenpairs of its inverse.

```{webr}
library(Matrix)
X=matrix(c(2,1,1,2),2,2) # you can try a matrix that is not full rank
ed=eigen(X) # spectral decomposition
rankMatrix(X) # calculate the rank; need package "Matrix"
ed$values # call eigenvalues
ed$vectors # call eigenvectors
Xinv=solve(X) # taking inverse of a matrix
edinv=eigen(Xinv)
edinv$values
edinv$vectors # eigenvectors are the same as X up to permutation and sign change.
```
